chapter.verse: Kote hong kingaihsutzia ding, hih bang ahi hi: Khris' nasemte leh Pasian' thusim thuthuk vai ah innsung thuvante bang ka hiding uh hi.
Tua banah innsung thuvante cih pen zong a muanhuai ahih ding uh kisam hi.

Tua hi a, no na hi uh zongin, mihing thukhen zum khatpeuh in ahi zongin, kei' tungah thu nong khen ding uh pen kei' adingin thu neuno khat hi lel hi. A taktakin keilekei nangawn thu a kikhenlo ka ahi hi.
A hang pen lungsim kisungsiat nading thu khat zong ka phawkkha kei a, ahi zongin tua tawh mawh a peng ka hi tuankei hi. Kei' tungah thu hong khen pen Topa ahi hi.

Tua ahih manin a kiseh hun hong tun ma, tu hun khuamial sunga kiseel thute hong theitelsak ding leh lungsim ngimna bulte a kitheikhiasak ding ahi Topa hong pai ma-in thukhenna bawl kei un. Tua hun ciangin mi khat ciat in Pasian' kiangpan pahtakna ngah tek ding uh hi.

Sanggamte aw, a kigelh thu khengvalin gamtat ding hilo cih ko' tungtawnin na tel nadingun ahi zongin, note kuamah in kiphatsakna tawh khat langpangin khat na paksak loh nadingun ahi zongin, hih thute khempeuh note' phattuam nadingin keimahmah' tungah leh Apollos' tungah ka zatsa ahi hi.
A hang pen kua in note a lianzaw-in hong ngaihsun ahi hiam? Hong kipia lo pi-a na neih uh bang om ahi hiam? Hong kipia ahihleh bang hangin note' neihtawm bang khatin kisial na hi uh hiam?
Na deih khempeuh uh lah nei khinta! Zong, hau khinta! Kote' om loh kalin kumpi zong suak khinta! Kumpi a semkhawm i hih theih nadingin kumpi na suah takpi ding uh ka deihdan!
Ko sawltakte pen Pasian in vanmite leh mite' mai, leitung bup' mai-ah a niampente bang, sih thukhenna thuak mite bangin hong laakkhia hi, ci-in ka ngaihsun hi.

Khris' thu hangin kote mihai bang ka hi uh a, no na hih uhleh Khris sungah na pil uh hi. Kote ka thanem uh a, no na hih uhleh na thakhauh uh hi. Note hong kithupimuh a, ko ka hih uhleh ka mindai uh hi.
Tu-a hunlenai ciangdong mah gilkial dangtakin ka om uh a, puansilh gina lo-in mi' vuak mi' sat thuakin innkip lokip nei lo-in ka om uh hi.
Komau' khut mah tawh nasemin nakpi ka hanciam uh hi. Hong kikosiat ciangin thupha ka paih uh a, hong kibawlsiat ciangin ka thuakzo uh hi.
Hong kigensiat ciangin ka thumbawl uh hi. Leitung ah vanval kipaai, ninbulom ka bang uh a, tu-in zong ka tuaci lai uh hi.
Hih thute kong gelh ciangin na maizum nading uh a ci hilo-in ka it ka tate bangin hong taaibawl ka hizaw hi.
A hang pen Khris sungah lamlak mi simzawhloh na neih uh hangin pa tampi na nei kei uh hi. Kei pen Lungdamna Thu hangin Khris Jesu sungah na pa uh ka hi hi.
Tua hi a, kei nong etteh nadingun kong hanthawn hi.

Note' kiangah Topa' sunga ka it leh ka muan ka tapa Timothy kong sawlna zong hih thu hang mah ahi hi. Khris Jesu sunga keima' zialetongte mun citenga om pawlpi citeng ah ka hilh mah bangin Amah in tuate note' kiangah hong phawksakkik ding hi.
Kei hong pai lo ding dan khatin kimkhat kihisak uh hi.
Ahih hangin Topa' deihna a om leh a sawt lo-in kong pai ding a, hih a kihisak mite, a thugen uh ahilo, a vangliatna uh, ka theikhia ding hi.
Banghanghiam cihleh Pasian' kumpigam cih pen vangliatna thu hi a, thugenna ciang bek hilo hi.
Kong pai ciangin ciangduai kong tawi ding leh a thunem lungsim tawh itna kong zat ding, koi na utzaw uh hiam?
